name: The Shadow Pass
title: The Shadow Pass
summary: The Shadow Pass is a narrow, snow-filled defile at 92.1-93.8N 56.7W, just south of Fiun Outpost. It runs north from a snow plateau (z 100); its floor lies at z 63-65 between walls 25-60 m high and is patched with dark obsidian ground. This is the old battlefield where Eleonora's army met King Varicci's. There are no structures, only Phantom, Poltergeist and Ruschk spawns. The landblocks north of y 46848 are missing from the kit.

site.name: The Shadow Pass
site.notes: Derived @teleloc on the snow plateau at the pass's southern lip (ground 100, nothing within 50 m); the gazetteer has no outdoor entry here (Frozen Library portal is 341 m away).

shots.standingOrder: Lock off 8 m above the snowy lip at the head of the Shadow Pass and look north down the dark gully of the old battlefield while the clouds race over it; nothing moves but the sky.
